cards.text: You give Des one address. He doesn't write it down.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Fate. Lovely." He's pleased in a way that takes a second to read as pleased. "That's one. We'll seed it soon and give it to someone in need."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Still want physics off you an' all. No rush,  just don't go thinking that's the job done."
By the end of the day, one patch you found has a vein in it. It may not be yours, but you helped make it happen.
